entry.title: The Non-Neutrality of Technology and Web Frameworks
entry.content:
Lobsters Top | deadsimpletech.com | discussion

Technology is not a neutral instrument, but a means of forming "human-tool gestalts" that shape behavior, thought patterns, and social ideologies. Applying Martin Heidegger's concept of "ready-to-hand" objects, the argument suggests that seamless tools function as extensions of human capability, subtly dictating the range of actions and perspectives available to users.

In web development, the differing designs of React and Vue create distinct professional hierarchies and team compositions by prioritizing either JavaScript or HTML. This pattern of tool-driven influence extends to societal examples like transportation and firearms, where the affordances of a tool can alter perception and social dynamics.
